header.title: CrossFadeView
header.description: Crossfade between two views (or any keyed substitute). Toggle `isSecond` to fade `first` out while `second` fades in — both slots stay stacked. For three or more views, pass `viewKey` plus `children`. `mode`: `sync` (overlap), `wait` (exit then enter), `pop-layout` (outgoing absolute). `keepState` keeps inactive panes mounted. `pagination` and `swipe` are Swiper-style.

playground.title: Playground
playground.description: Combine mode, pagination, and swipe. Incoming uses `enter` timing; outgoing uses `exit`. With `pagination={3}` use Back / Next (`viewKey` mode).
playground.firstCopy: First view. Switch to Second to crossfade.
playground.secondCopy: Second view. The previous pane fades out underneath.
playground.pageCopy: Active view for {tab}. Use Back / Next or the dots.

base.title: Base
base.description: Toggle `isSecond`. Both panes stay stacked; dots from `pagination` mark the active view.

texts.firstCopy: First view. Switch to Second to crossfade.
texts.secondCopy: Second view. The previous pane fades out underneath.

timing.title: Enter / exit timing
timing.description: `duration`, `delay`, and `easing` accept `{ enter, exit }`. Incoming uses enter; outgoing uses exit.

heights.title: Different heights
heights.description: Both slots stay mounted and share one grid cell, so the host is as tall as the larger view. Pair with AutoAnimateContainer if that height should tween.

texts.tallCopy: Extra copy so the stacked host grows while both panes are mounted, then settles to this height when the outgoing unmounts.
texts.sibling: Sibling below — moves when the host height changes.

viewKey.title: viewKey
viewKey.description: Three substitutes via `viewKey`. Pass `pagination` and `paginationIndex` so the dots follow the keyed view.

texts.copy: Active view for {tab}. Change the key to crossfade.

modeWait.title: mode wait
modeWait.description: `mode="wait"` finishes the outgoing fade before the incoming pane mounts and fades in.

texts.firstCopy: Fully exits before the other enters.

modePopLayout.title: mode pop-layout
modePopLayout.description: `mode="pop-layout"` pulls the outgoing out of flow (`position: absolute`) so the host sizes to the incoming pane and sibling content below follows the active height immediately.

texts.tallCopy: Extra copy — with pop-layout the host sizes to the incoming while the outgoing is absolute.
texts.sibling: Sibling below — follows the active height immediately.

keepState.title: keepState
keepState.description: `keepState` keeps visited panes mounted (`display: none`). Type in a field, switch tabs, return — the value survives. `onViewChange` logs below.

paginationOverlay.title: Pagination overlay
paginationOverlay.description: `pagination.placement = "inside-end"` overlays the dots on the card, like Swiper.

texts.firstCopy: Dots at the bottom, on top of the panel.
texts.secondCopy: Same overlay on the second view.

swipe.title: swipe
swipe.description: `swipe` — drag the card sideways; the pane follows the pointer, then crossfades on commit (or settles back below threshold). Pass `swipe.axis = "y"` for vertical.

texts.firstCopy: Drag left to go to Sent.

paginationTop.title: Pagination top
paginationTop.description: `inside-start` pins the dots to the top edge of the pane.

paginationColors.title: Pagination colors
paginationColors.description: Customize with `color`, `activeColor`, `size`, and `gap`. Also overridable via CSS `--gemst-cross-fade-pagination-*`.

texts.firstCopy: Dots with an info active color.

callbacks.title: Events
callbacks.description: `onViewChange` fires when the active identity changes. `onCrossFade` / `outCrossFade` mark the start and end of the crossfade.

disabled.title: Disabled
disabled.description: With `isDisabled` (or `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce`) the active slot snaps in with no overlap.

asChild.title: No wrapper (asChild)
asChild.description: With `asChild`, host styles merge onto the `section`. Pass `first` / `second` as the panes — the child is only the host.

utilities.title: Utility classes
utilities.description: Pass `utilities.css` helpers via `classNames`. This demo applies `gemst-relative` / `gemst-overflow-hidden` on `root` and `gemst-block` on `pane`.

header.title: CrossFadeView API
header.description: Props, inheritance, accessibility, CSS classes and variables, and exported types for `CrossFadeView`.

demos.title: Demos
demos.description: Playground and examples for slots, viewKey, modes, pagination, and swipe.

import.title: Import
import.description: Import from `@gem-org/gemsitions/cross-fade-view` with its `cross-fade-view.css`, or from the root if you already load `styles.css`.

inheritance.title: Inheritance
inheritance.body: Accepts HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement> and forwards them to the root div, or to the child with asChild. In slot mode with asChild, the child is only the host — panes replace its children. The component handles the end of opacity on each pane and then calls your handlers.

items.presence: This is a view swap: the control that changes isSecond / viewKey should reflect state. Do not convey information with the fade alone.
items.pagination: With onPagination, dots are buttons. Without it, they are decorative (span) and swipe is ignored.
items.swipe: swipe needs onPagination and a count ≥ 2. On touch, touch-action follows the axis. Do not make swipe the only way to change views.
items.reducedMotion: With prefers-reduced-motion: reduce panes snap to the final state. The preference is read each render.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: ignoreReducedMotion keeps the animation and adds gemst-ignore-reduced-motion. Only when motion is essential.
items.keepState: With keepState, inactive panes stay with display: none. They should not receive focus or be announced while hidden.
items.asChild: With asChild, pick a host with the right semantics (section, div): that element is the crossfade container.

items.root: Root (`div`, or the child with `asChild`). `display: grid` (or `block` in pop-layout).
items.modePop: pop-layout mode: outgoing absolute, host sizes to incoming.
items.playing: Crossfade in progress (`will-change: opacity` on active panes).

cssVariables.title: CSS variables
cssVariables.description: Written inline each render from the current phase (enter/exit) and swipe/pagination state.

tokens.title: Tokens
tokens.description: Global gemsitions variables used as CSS defaults.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Active identity, mode, pagination, and swipe.

events.title: Events
events.description: View change, pagination, and crossfade cycle.

items.children: Current view when `first` / `second` are omitted. Identity is `viewKey` or the child’s `key`. With `asChild` and slots, this is the host only.
items.first: First / default view. Use with `second` and `isSecond`.
items.second: Second / alternate view. Use with `first` and `isSecond`.
items.asChild: Applies classes, styles, and ref to the single child (no extra wrapper). With slots, the child is the host and panes replace its children.
items.viewKey: Stable identity for `children`. Required for a crossfade when the child has no `key`. Ignored when `first` / `second` are set.
items.mode: `sync` overlaps enter/exit; `wait` finishes exit before mounting enter; `pop-layout` makes outgoing absolute so the host sizes to incoming.
items.keepState: Keeps inactive panes mounted (`display: none`) so local state survives when returning.
items.unmountOnExit: Skips the fade. Slot mode also unmounts the inactive pane.
items.pagination: Swiper-style dots. Number = count, or an object with `placement`, `color`, `activeColor`, `size`, `gap`.
items.paginationIndex: Active dot (0-based). Defaults to `1` when `isSecond`, a numeric `viewKey`, or `0`.
items.swipe: `true` = horizontal axis + pagination count (or 2 in slots). Requires `onPagination` and count ≥ 2. Swipe left = next.
items.duration: Duration. With `{ enter, exit }`, `enter` is incoming and `exit` is outgoing.
items.delay: Wait before each fade. Accepts `{ enter, exit }`.
items.easing: Token, timing function, or `{ enter, exit }`. Default enter `standard`, exit `exit`.
items.isDisabled: Snaps to the active view with no interpolation.
items.ignoreReducedMotion: Animates even when the user prefers reduced motion. Only if essential.
items.onPagination: Dot pressed or swipe that commits a page. Update `isSecond` / `viewKey` here. Without this, dots are decorative and swipe is ignored.
items.onViewChange: After the active identity changes (skips the first mount). Keys: `viewKey`, `first`/`second`, or the child key.
items.outCrossFade: When the crossfade settles, motion is disabled, or the host unmounts.
items.style: Inline styles for the root. Combined with `--gemst-cross-fade-*`.
items.ref: Ref to the root (the `div`, or the child with `asChild`).
